events.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Rey — if you can bring a drill, some screws, and maybe a couple work gloves, that’d be a huge help. I’m probably running a little late, but I’ll be there soon.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll bring the drill, screws, and gloves. Take your time; I’ll see you soon.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Rey—I’ll send the repair drive details and start spreading the word around the neighborhood. We can get a few more hands on deck and fix up a lot together.

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — send me the details and I’ll keep an eye out. Happy to help however I can.

events.text: Quinn: Perfect, Rey — I’ll send the details right over and I’ll keep spreading the word so we can get a good crew together. Thanks for bringing the drill, screws, and gloves!

events.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. I’ll watch for the details and be ready to help when everyone gets there.

events.text: Pia: That sounds good to me—can we set a specific time, list the tools, and confirm the drop-off spot before we tell anyone?
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Rey: Yes — let’s lock in the time, tools, and drop-off spot first, and then we can share it out.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Pia: Great — once you’ve got the final time and drop-off spot, send them my way and I’ll help make sure everyone knows to avoid pickup hours.

events.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the repair list when you’ve got it, and I’ll take a quick look.
